---
description: Configure login and write the first tests from the golden templates
---

Read [template-fw/docs/FIRST_TESTS_PROMPT.md](../../template-fw/docs/FIRST_TESTS_PROMPT.md) and follow the prompt block in it, step by step, with its stops for human review.

Use the application context the user wrote after the command. If a context field of the prompt is missing, ask for it before step 1. Never ask for, write or log credentials.
